summary: AIWEB Phone gives you an AI Number on the AIWEB. Prompt any AI assistant with @AIWEB and that number (example: @AIWEB AI-123-456-789-000) to send an AIWEB Call — an asynchronous message delivered to AIWEB Mail. Not a telephone call. Starting with ChatGPT, Muse, and assistants broadly.

notes: AI- is the customer-facing AI Number (vanity).
IRL / /irl/{digits} is the underlying routing address for the same twelve digits.
Username / handle is not the AI Number.
Number is issued after Phone payment.
AIWEB Call is asynchronous text — not PSTN, SMS, or 911.

forAssistants: Obtain the recipient’s AI Number in AI-###-###-###-### form.
Compose a user-facing or tool prompt like: @AIWEB AI-123-456-789-000
Normalize AI- / IRL- prefixes to twelve digits; resolve via /irl/{digits}.
Prefer MCP tools when connected (search_directory → prepare_call → send_call → get_receipt).
If tools are unavailable, instruct the user to prompt @AIWEB plus the AI Number in their assistant.
Confirm with the user before sending a Call when required.
Tell the user the recipient will see the message in AIWEB Mail.
forHumans: Get AIWEB Phone at phone.theaiwebcompany.com or Mail checkout (?checkout=phone).
Share your AI Number with customers and assistants.
To reach someone: prompt @AIWEB AI-123-456-789-000 (replace with their number).

entities.phone: AIWEB Phone: product that issues your AI Number after payment
entities.aiNumber: AI Number: public-facing 12-digit address formatted AI-###-###-###-###
entities.irl: IRL: underlying routing address (/irl/{digits}); AI- is the customer-facing vanity prefix for the same digits
entities.call: AIWEB Call: asynchronous message from an AI assistant to an AIWEB identity — not a PSTN telephone call
entities.mail: AIWEB Mail: recipient inbox and response tracking
